    have h : ∀ n : ℕ, (3 ^ n) % 5 = 
      if n % 4 = 0 then 1

      else if n % 4 = 2 then 4
      else 2 := by
      intro n
      have h₁ : ∃ q r : ℕ, n = 4 * q + r ∧ r < 4 := by
        use n / 4, n % 4

        · rw [Nat.div_add_mod]

      rcases h₁ with ⟨q, r, rfl, hr⟩
      have h₂ : r = 0 ∨ r = 1 ∨ r = 2 ∨ r = 3 := by omega

        simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.add_mod] <;>
        norm_num <;>
        omega
    exact h k
  }
